_comment: Image/video model registry (config). Data only: adding a model = adding an entry here.
files: sd-server CLI flag (without --) -> file name under MODELS_DIR. args: extra sd-server flags (sampling defaults).
vram_gb: MEASURED 'total params memory size' from the backend's load log (not the file size);
compute_gb: GPU headroom reserved on top of vram_gb while the model is resident (video needs far more).
ui: the defaults offered for this model (edit = takes reference images; fixed_steps = a --sigmas preset
governs the step count; frame_step / frame_base = the frame-count grid of a video model).
family: which model family it belongs to -- decides which LoRAs fit. kind: 'image' (default) or 'video'.
engine: optional sd-server path relative to the repo root, for a model the default build can't load.
default_lora: LoRAs the server adds to every request for this model (e.g. a turbo LoRA its steps assume).

models.label: Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo
models.description: Best open model for generation AND editing (Artificial Analysis #1, Oct 2026). 8 fixed steps: ~1.5 min at 1024x1024, ~2 min per edit.

ui.note: Turbo runs at CFG 1: the negative prompt only takes effect with CFG > 1 (about 2x the time).

models.label: Qwen-Image 2.1 (full quality)
models.description: The non-distilled base model: 40 steps with real CFG. Best quality, ~12 min at 1024x1024.

ui.note: Slow: two passes per step (CFG). Use 512 drafts to iterate, then render at full size.

models.label: Kroma (uncensored, photoreal)
models.description: Krea 2 fine-tune on the Chroma dataset by the Chroma author: the strongest open uncensored photoreal model loadable here (Oct 2026). 12.9B, turbo, ~10 steps.
models.licence: MIT + Krea 2 Community License (commercial cap; bans non-consensual intimate imagery)

ui.note: Turbo: 8-12 steps at CFG 1. The negative prompt needs CFG > 1 (about 2x the time). Adult content: keep it legal and consensual.

models.label: Anima Turbo (uncensored, anime)
models.description: Anime / illustration model (2B, Cosmos-Predict2 base), the top anime family on CivitAI this month. Fast. Danbooru tags and plain language both work.
models.licence: CircleStone non-commercial + NVIDIA Open Model License (outputs usable)

ui.note: Rating tags steer content: safe, sensitive, nsfw, explicit. Turbo: 8-12 steps at CFG 1.

models.label: Z-Image Turbo (fast)
models.description: Tongyi-MAI's 6B distilled model: the fast general option. 8 steps at CFG 1, strong photorealism and English/Chinese text rendering. Generation only (no edit).

ui.note: Turbo: 8 steps at CFG 1. The negative prompt needs CFG > 1 (about 2x the time).

models.label: Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B Turbo (video)
models.description: Text->video and image->video in one 5B model: 4 steps, 24 fps, 1280x704. A 2 s clip at full size takes ~1.5 min.

ui.note: Distilled: 4 steps at CFG 1. Frames are rounded to 4n+1 (49 = 2 s, 121 = 5 s at 24 fps). Decoded with the tiny TAEHV decoder: ~10x faster than the full Wan VAE here (92 s vs 705-972 s for 49 frames at 1280x704), slightly softer.

models.label: Wan 2.2 I2V-A14B 4-step (video, quality)
models.description: Image->video with the 27B two-expert Wan 2.2 (lightx2v 4-step distill): the best motion here. ~9.5 min for 3 s at 832x480.

ui.note: Distilled: 2 high-noise + 2 low-noise steps at CFG 1, 16 fps (49 frames = 3 s, 81 = 5 s). Measured: 832x480 x 49 frames = 565 s (190 s per expert + 126 s decode).

models.label: FLUX.3 Image Klein
models.description: Black Forest Labs' newest open model (Oct 2026): 5.6B, 16 steps at CFG 1, generation AND editing with up to 10 reference images.
models.licence: FLUX Kommunity License (free commercial use under $5M revenue)

ui.note: Distilled: 16 steps at CFG 1. Edit with up to 10 reference images (call them image 1, image 2...).

models.label: LTX-2.3 (video with sound)
models.description: Lightricks' 22B video model, distilled (8 steps), with a generated SOUNDTRACK: text->video, image->video, first + last frame. 2 s at 768x512 in ~3 min.
models.licence: LTX-2 Community License (free incl. commercial under $10M revenue) + Gemma terms (text encoder)

ui.note: Distilled: 8 steps at CFG 1 (Lightricks' distilled sigma schedule). Frames are 8n+1 (49 = 2 s, 121 = 5 s at 24 fps); width and height multiples of 32. The video comes with generated sound.

models.label: MiniMax H3 (video with sound)
models.description: MiniMax's 33B omni-modal video model (pruned FL2VA, Q8_0) with the lightx2v 8-step turbo LoRA: text->video and first / last frame->video with stereo sound, 24 fps. 864x480 x 56 frames (2.3 s) in ~7 min.
models.licence: MiniMax H3 Community License: NOT licensed in the EU, UK, US or South Korea; commercial use must show "MiniMax H3"; written authorisation above $20M revenue

ui.note: 8 steps with the turbo LoRA (applied automatically). Frames sit on a 17k+5 grid (56 = 2.3 s, 124 = 5.2 s at 24 fps); always 24 fps; sizes multiples of 32. Describe the sound too: it renders stereo audio with the picture.
